## Raw Concept

Sponsor of OSCP / OSWE / OSWA / OSED / OSEP / OSDA / OSWP / OSEE — cited across the corpus.

## Narrative

Cybersecurity training + certification vendor founded 2007 by Mati Aharoni (muts). Steward of Kali Linux. Operates the OSCP, OSWE, OSWA, OSED, OSEP, OSDA, OSWP, OSEE certifications and the proving-grounds lab platform. [CONFIRMED]

**Culture:** "Try Harder" mantra; minimal hand-holding; courses are written-text-heavy. Lab learning is the centerpiece — videos exist but the labs do the teaching.
